origin_subject: Index ledger_key only after the migration adds it.
prompt:
Opening a memor database created by an earlier version crashes with `sqlite3.OperationalError: no such column: ledger_key`. A brand-new database opens fine; only an existing one that predates that column fails, so upgrading breaks every install that already had data. Find the cause and fix it. The relevant tests are in tests/test_proxy_ledger.py.

Run the tests to see the current failures, then change the source so they pass. Do not edit anything under tests/ — the test files are restored from git before grading, so changes there are discarded. Do not change unrelated behaviour.
